The '''1923–24 Scottish Division One''' season was won by [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]] by nine points over nearest rival [[Airdrieonians F.C. (1878)|Airdrieonians]]. [[Clyde F.C.|Clyde]] and [[Clydebank F.C. (1914)|Clydebank]] finished 19th and 20th respectively and were relegated to the [[1924–25 Scottish Division Two]].
